info.title: Tutor Booking Frontend API
info.description: Contract for the implemented Laravel API. All time inputs are UTC. Dates and IDs in examples are illustrative. Full frontend rules and testing instructions are in FRONTEND_GUIDE.md.

servers.description: Local Laravel server; change the port if necessary.

post.description: Access: Public. Creates an active student or tutor and immediately issues a token. Tutor accounts start without a complete profile. Admin self-registration is rejected.

422.description: Invalid role, duplicate email, weak/mismatched password, prohibited fields.

429.description: Too many requests. Auth: 10/min per IP; protected API: 120/min per user.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Do not automatically retry a mutation.

post.description: Access: Public. Issues a new token per successful login. No refresh token or expires_at is returned. The current Sanctum configuration has no automatic token expiry.

Booked portions are still included here; this is the editing view, not the student booking picker. An already-started range may be listed but cannot be edited/deleted. put.description: Access: Owning tutor only. Send all three time fields. The original range must not have started. The new range must be future, non-overlapping, and still contain every active booking depending on the original range. Moving it to another date is possible only when these rules permit.

get.description: Access: Student: own; tutor: own; admin: all. No period means all history, including future cancelled/rejected sessions. upcoming includes pending/confirmed with end > now (including in-progress sessions). past includes all statuses with end <= now. Past sorts start descending; otherwise start ascending; ties by ID. All filters combine with AND. Admin IDs only filter admin requests; students/tutors remain scoped to themselves.

post.description: Access: Student only. The chosen tutor must be active, have a rate and at least one subject. Start must be future; interval must fit entirely inside ONE availability record. Neither participant may have an overlapping pending/confirmed booking. Price and ownership are server-controlled. Always creates pending. No subject selection is attached to a booking.

patch.description: Access: Owning student only. Original booking must be pending/confirmed, future and at least cutoff hours away (default 24). New time must meet all create-booking checks. Tutor cannot change. Original hourly rate is retained; total is recalculated. Successful reschedule always returns pending and notifies both users, even if the previous booking was pending. A failed request preserves the original reservation. Do not send tutor_id/student_id/status/hourly_rate/total_price.

bearerAuth.description: Laravel Sanctum personal access token returned by login/register.

TimeInput.description: UTC, minute precision, same calendar day; end after start, start strictly in future.

BookingInput.description: Do not send student_id, status, hourly_rate or total_price. The server determines these values.

RegisterInput.description: Email must be unique. Password confirmation must match. Do not send is_active or hourly_rate.

hourly_rate.description: Numeric value from 0.01 to 999999.99 with at most two decimal places; string form is also accepted.

TutorProfileInput.description: All subject IDs must exist. Subject list replaces the previous list. Do not send role or is_active.
